RIB-path AS_PATH is unaffected (canonicalized to 4-byte).

Four MUST-level receive-side gaps annotated in `rfc/short/rfc7313.md`: RFC7313-4-4/4-5 -- a received BoRR/EoRR is log-only (internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/rib.go), so ze marks no Adj-RIB-In routes stale and purges none; and RFC7313-4-6/4-7 -- neither the send nor receive path applies a Graceful-Restart End-of-RIB gate to BoRR emission or acceptance. One feature is absent by decision, and it is not a conformance gap: ze starts no locally initiated route refresh (soft clear only asks the peer for its refresh), so the BoRR obligation conditional on one, RFC7313-4-13, is annotated {feature-declined}.
